test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.

Wily
solution:
The correct answer is **Crafty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wily: **clever at getting what one wants.
 
• **Crafty: **clever at getting or achieving things by using unfair or dishonest methods.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym of the given word is given in **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frank: **showing one's thoughts and feelings clearly.
 
• **Friendly: **behaving in a kind and open way.
 
• **Honest: **telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing.
